c1-08-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Officially Announced
c1-08-01.scenario: A friend asks what happened to the decision about your complaint.
c1-08-01.prompt: Say in the official way that the decision was announced today.
c1-08-01.target: A határozat a mai napon kihirdetésre került.
c1-08-01.canDo: I can use *-ásra/-ésre kerül* and *kihirdetésre vár* in an official report.

c1-08-02.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Inspection
c1-08-02.scenario: A colleague asks when the decision will be made.
c1-08-02.prompt: Say in an official way that it will follow the on-site inspection.
cues: Use a noun phrase for the inspection
c1-08-02.target: A helyszíni szemle lefolytatását követően hoznak döntést.
c1-08-02.english: Following the conduct of the on-site inspection, a decision is made.
c1-08-02.canDo: I can turn a clause into a noun phrase with *-ás/-és* (*A hatáskör átruházását megelőzően …*).

c1-08-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Refused, Officially
c1-08-03.scenario: A friend asks why the application was refused.
c1-08-03.prompt: Say officially, without naming a person, that it was refused for lack of legal basis.
c1-08-03.target: A kérelem jogalap hiányában elutasításra került.
c1-08-03.english: The application was refused for lack of a legal basis.
c1-08-03.canDo: I can write an official refusal without naming a person (*jogalap hiányában elutasításra került*).

c1-08-04.title: Communicative Challenge: To Court
c1-08-04.scenario: A friend wants to go to court against the decision of an authority.
c1-08-04.prompt: Say what the claim asks of the court.
cues: Say what the court should do
c1-08-04.target: A felperes a határozat megsemmisítését kéri.
c1-08-04.english: The plaintiff asks for the annulment of the decision.
c1-08-04.canDo: I can say that a citizen can go to court against an administrative decision (*közigazgatási per*).

c1-08-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Text Says About Offices
c1-08-05.scenario: You have read a short text about Kálmán Mikszáth, and a friend asks what it says about the county offices.
c1-08-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the text says about the county offices.
cues: Say what the office was for the gentry
c1-08-05.target: A szöveg szerint a vármegyei hivatal a dzsentri menedéke volt.
c1-08-05.english: According to the text, the county office was the refuge of the gentry.
c1-08-05.canDo: I can say what the text about Mikszáth says about county offices and patronage.

c1-08-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Refused, Then Annulled
c1-08-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks what happened to a refused application.
c1-08-consolidation.prompt: Say that it was refused, but the court annulled the decision.
cues: Use the official phrase for the refusal
c1-08-consolidation.target: A kérelem elutasításra került, de a bíróság a határozatot hatályon kívül helyezte.
c1-08-consolidation.english: The application was refused, but the court set the decision aside.
c1-08-consolidation.canDo: I can use *-ásra/-ésre került* and *részesül* in an official report.
